name: Chaikin Money Flow
description: This keyword returns the Chaikin Money Flow of any period of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Chaikin Money Flow of any period of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword.

![Example](./images/img-1716369279.png)

The above keyword will return the Chaikin  Money Flow  of Nifty 50 spot on 5 mins candle with 15 period.
